name: Arcade Title
description: A retro game title screen in big hard-edged pixels: dithered sky, parallax hills, city or space scrolling in whole pixels, a running sprite, a bitmap title that drops in with a bounce and a blinking "press start".
useWhen: Playful, nostalgic or gaming moments: an intro or chapter card ("Level 2"), a launch framed as a game, an indie game or 8-bit music promo, an "achievement unlocked" beat, a fun end card. Keep the title short (one to three words) so the pixels stay big.

title.label: Title
title.help: A–Z, 0–9 and basic punctuation, shown in capitals.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.help: Blinks under the title. Leave empty for none.

resolution.label: Pixels
resolution.help: Virtual pixels across the short side: lower is chunkier.

spriteFps.label: Frame rate
spriteFps.help: Everything moves in steps at this rate, like a sprite sheet.
